metadata.description: Van50 Registry of Approved Holidays and Seasonal Themes with 1-line and expandable descriptions

approvedHolidays.label: Halloween
approvedHolidays.short_description: Spooky screenings, horror cinema, murder mysteries, and costume nights across Vancouver.
approvedHolidays.long_description: Celebrate Halloween season across Metro Vancouver with cult horror film screenings, live film scores, improvised murder mysteries, paranormal comedy shows, and late-night costume parties—all verified under $50 CAD.

approvedHolidays.label: Día de los Muertos / Day of the Dead
approvedHolidays.short_description: Traditional Mexican markets, Catrinas processions, ofrendas, folkloric music, and art.
approvedHolidays.long_description: Honour loved ones during Día de los Muertos with community altars (ofrendas), twilight Catrinas processions, traditional Mexican artisan markets, mariachi music, and cultural performances across Granville Island and Gastown.

approvedHolidays.label: Diwali Festival of Lights
approvedHolidays.short_description: South Asian music, dance, rangoli art, and Festival of Lights celebrations.
approvedHolidays.long_description: Experience the annual Diwali Festival of Lights across Metro Vancouver with classical and contemporary South Asian music, bhangra and kathak dance showcases, rangoli art installations, and community markets.

approvedHolidays.label: Thanksgiving
approvedHolidays.short_description: Autumn harvest markets, long-weekend outings, and seasonal comedy & music.
approvedHolidays.long_description: Enjoy Canadian Thanksgiving long-weekend outings across Metro Vancouver, featuring autumn harvest markets, scenic fall foliage strolls, and festive comedy and live music showcases.

approvedHolidays.label: Winter Holidays & Christmas
approvedHolidays.short_description: Festive light displays, winter craft markets, holiday concerts, and seasonal theatre.
approvedHolidays.long_description: Celebrate the winter holiday season across Metro Vancouver with botanical garden light displays, indie artisan craft markets, festive choir and jazz concerts, ugly sweater comedy nights, and holiday cinema under $50 CAD.

approvedHolidays.label: New Year's Eve / Day
approvedHolidays.short_description: New Year's Eve countdown parties, comedy galas, live music, and Polar Bear Swim.
approvedHolidays.long_description: Ring in the New Year with countdown dance parties, NYE stand-up comedy galas, live concerts, and Vancouver's iconic New Year's Day Polar Bear Swim at English Bay.

approvedHolidays.label: Lunar New Year
approvedHolidays.short_description: Chinatown lion dances, lantern installations, cultural markets, and festive performances.
approvedHolidays.long_description: Welcome the Lunar New Year across historic Chinatown and Metro Vancouver with traditional lion and dragon dances, lantern light installations, festive markets, and multidisciplinary cultural showcases.

approvedHolidays.label: Valentine's Day
approvedHolidays.short_description: Date-night concerts, rom-com screenings, burlesque, and Galentine's comedy shows.
approvedHolidays.long_description: Celebrate Valentine's Day, Galentine's, or Anti-Valentine's across Vancouver with candlelit jazz, cult romance film screenings, burlesque cabarets, and relationship-themed improv and stand-up comedy.

approvedHolidays.label: St. Patrick's Day
approvedHolidays.short_description: Celtic live music, Irish dance, fiddle sessions, and St. Paddy's pub celebrations.
approvedHolidays.long_description: Raise a glass for St. Patrick's Day with high-energy Celtic folk bands, traditional Irish fiddle and céilí dancing, and festive live music nights across Vancouver.

approvedHolidays.label: Easter & Spring
approvedHolidays.short_description: Spring garden blooms, artisan markets, and long-weekend cultural outings.
approvedHolidays.long_description: Enjoy the Easter and spring season across Metro Vancouver with botanical garden blooms, family-friendly park activities, spring artisan markets, and long-weekend live shows.

approvedHolidays.label: Canada Day
approvedHolidays.short_description: Waterfront festivals, free outdoor concerts, and community celebrations.
approvedHolidays.long_description: Explore Canada Day community events across Canada Place, Granville Island, and local neighbourhood parks featuring free outdoor stages, multicultural performances, and waterfront celebrations.

approvedHolidays.label: Pride Festival
approvedHolidays.short_description: Queer arts, drag showcases, parade celebrations, and community stages.
approvedHolidays.long_description: Celebrate Vancouver Pride with 2SLGBTQIA+ cabaret, drag showcases, queer film screenings, outdoor community stages, and parade festivities across the West End, Davie Village, and Downtown.
